_note: Versioned definitions for harmonic essential-star scoring. Supporting stars provide a bounded bonus; signature evidence and guards govern eligibility. Eclectic is pending a diversity definition.

constellations.name: Whimsigoth
constellations.blurb: Velvet, moons, and the sense that you own at least one crystal ball. Gothic, but it had a nice time in the 90s.
constellations.signature: Mystical or celestial motifs combined with flowing, layered, or richly textured bohemian pieces.
constellations.guardrail: Black clothing or a moon necklace alone is insufficient.

constellations.name: Romantic goth
constellations.signature: Dark romantic construction: lace, corsetry, velvet, rose motifs, or dramatic flowing silhouettes.
constellations.guardrail: Lace alone also occurs in non-gothic wardrobes.

constellations.name: Victorian goth
constellations.signature: Period-inspired construction such as high-neck lace, jabot, cameo, bustle, brocade, or Victorian boots.
constellations.guardrail: Vintage should not mean every older-looking graphic tee.

constellations.name: Gothic Lolita
constellations.signature: Repeated structured bell-shaped or A-line dresses/skirts with coordinated blouse, lace, bows, or petticoat evidence.
constellations.guardrail: Cute plus Gothic is not enough; Lolita has a specific clothing silhouette.

constellations.name: Trad goth
constellations.signature: Repeated post-punk/goth styling evidence: fishnet or mesh, dark hardware, pointed footwear, distressed layering, or relevant graphic references.
constellations.guardrail: Gothic plus Edgy or Punk on the piece, with corroborating construction/hardware or an explicit tradition reference; mesh or skull alone cannot qualify.

constellations.name: Nu-goth
constellations.signature: Dark restrained silhouettes with occult, geometric, sheer-layered, or sharp-line evidence.
constellations.guardrail: Minimalist alone must not carry the result.

constellations.name: Pastel goth
constellations.signature: Pastel palette deliberately paired with dark/spooky motifs or goth construction.
constellations.guardrail: Pastel alone or a Halloween item alone is insufficient.

constellations.name: Vampire glam
constellations.signature: Opulent dark eveningwear or jewelry: velvet/satin drama, ornate chokers, corsetry, or vampire motifs.
constellations.guardrail: Do not infer sexuality or personal identity from the result.

constellations.name: Cybergoth
constellations.signature: Repeated industrial-futuristic/rave evidence: neon with dark hardware, reflective/PVC surfaces, goggles, or cyber motifs.
constellations.guardrail: Y2K is supporting, not mandatory; a robot tee alone is not Cybergoth.

constellations.name: Witchcore
constellations.signature: Occult, herbal, celestial, ritual, or folklore motifs recur across pieces, with nature or draped styling evidence.
constellations.guardrail: Not every botanical print or crystal-colored bead is witchy.

constellations.name: Spooky season
constellations.signature: Explicit Halloween or spooky motifs such as ghosts, jack-o-lanterns, haunted imagery, or skeleton graphics.
constellations.guardrail: Holiday-themed alone could mean Christmas; skulls can also be Punk/Gothic.

constellations.name: Riot grrrl
constellations.signature: DIY, protest, feminist, zine, band, or deliberately subversive clothing references corroborated by punk styling.
constellations.guardrail: Do not require Cute or infer politics from a plaid skirt.

constellations.name: E-girl
constellations.signature: Repeated contrast between cute/digital references and dark chains, stripes, mesh, pleats, or layered street styling.
constellations.guardrail: A heart motif or anime reference alone is insufficient; no age/gender inference.

constellations.name: Indie sleaze
constellations.signature: Disheveled partywear contrast: distressed pieces with sequins/metallics, skinny tailoring, leopard, or mini silhouettes.
constellations.guardrail: Leopard alone is not enough; distinguish from polished Glam.

constellations.name: Balletcore
constellations.signature: Ballet-linked shapes recur: ballet flats, wrap knits, leg warmers, leotard shapes, tulle, or ribbon details.
constellations.guardrail: A single bow or generic wrap top is not a complete ballet affinity.

constellations.name: Fairycore
constellations.signature: Ethereal/nature styling: petal or handkerchief hems, airy layers, butterfly/woodland motifs, or iridescence.
constellations.guardrail: Not every floral dress is Fairycore.

constellations.name: Baroque romance
constellations.signature: Ornate historical decoration: damask, brocade, elaborate scrolling, rich embroidery, or substantial ornament.
constellations.guardrail: Velvet alone is too broad.

constellations.name: Regencycore
constellations.signature: Regency-linked silhouette or construction: empire waist, period sleeve/neckline, spencer-style jacket, or coordinated period accessories.
constellations.guardrail: Puff sleeves or floral fabric alone are insufficient.

constellations.name: Soft girl
constellations.signature: Repeated soft/pastel styling with gentle silhouettes, small playful motifs, or ribbon/ruffle details.
constellations.guardrail: Cozy should support, not be a hard requirement.

constellations.name: Old Hollywood
constellations.signature: Period evening silhouettes: bias gowns, dramatic draping, satin gloves, sculpted tailoring, or strong vintage occasionwear evidence.
constellations.guardrail: Formalwear alone does not establish an era.

constellations.name: Boudoir
constellations.signature: Styling-oriented lingerie references: visible lace/satin, slip shapes, corsetry, or decorative bodysuits.
constellations.guardrail: Functional bras/underwear and Everyday basics do not establish this style.

constellations.name: Disco
constellations.signature: Dance/1970s party evidence: flared or jumpsuit silhouettes with sequins, metallics, lurex-like finish, or disco motifs.
constellations.guardrail: Glitter without a retro or dance connection is generic Glam.

constellations.name: Parisian chic
constellations.signature: Repeated restrained combinations of Breton stripes, trench-style outerwear, ballet flats, beret, or scarf styling.
constellations.guardrail: Stripes or a French slogan alone are insufficient; this is styling, not nationality.

constellations.name: Dark academia
constellations.signature: Scholarly/heritage tailoring or literary motifs recur: tweed/herringbone, argyle, waistcoats, pleated tailoring, loafers, or book references in a dark/muted context.
constellations.guardrail: Propose naming this constellation Dark academia; Vintage librarian becomes supporting flavor, not a four-star gate.

constellations.name: Light academia
constellations.signature: Light-toned scholarly tailoring with soft period details: pleats, waistcoats, poet blouses, knits, or literary references.
constellations.guardrail: Cream color alone is not academic; Cozy is optional.

constellations.name: Old money
constellations.signature: Repeated heritage-prep styling: polos, cable knits, riding-inspired shapes, loafers, or restrained tailoring.
constellations.guardrail: Never infer wealth, garment quality, authenticity, or price from titles or brands.

constellations.name: Grandmacore
constellations.signature: Repeated nostalgic domestic craft signals: crochet, patchwork, doily-like lace, embroidered cardigans, or small traditional florals.
constellations.guardrail: A generic knit cardigan is too broad; no age inference.

constellations.name: 60s mod
constellations.signature: A repeated 1960s design cluster: shift/A-line mini silhouettes, go-go boots, optical/geometric prints, sharp color blocking, or mod tailoring.
constellations.guardrail: Retro + Quirky is explicitly insufficient; generic stripes, any mini, or a cloud sweater do not establish Mod.

constellations.name: Pinup
constellations.signature: Repeated mid-century silhouette evidence: fitted-waist swing shapes, sweetheart/halter construction, wiggle/pencil styling, or period-linked prints.
constellations.guardrail: Cherry print alone is insufficient; Sexy is not mandatory.

constellations.name: Rockabilly
constellations.signature: Rock-and-roll/workwear contrast: bowling shirts, cuffed denim, bandana styling, creepers, or mid-century silhouettes with edgy details.
constellations.guardrail: Do not require Punk or assume leopard/cherries alone identify the subculture.

constellations.name: Tenniscore
constellations.signature: Court-linked pieces recur: tennis skirts, polos, cricket/tennis knits, court shoes, or racket motifs.
constellations.guardrail: Pleats alone also occur in academic and punk styles.

constellations.name: 70s boho
constellations.signature: A repeated 1970s bohemian cluster: flares, bell sleeves, crochet, suede-like textures, paisley, fringe, or flowing maxi shapes.
constellations.guardrail: Generic florals and vest types are insufficient. A flare title and the same flared shape are one signal, not corroboration.

constellations.name: Prairie
constellations.signature: Repeated rural-period construction: tiered/ruffled long skirts, calico/gingham, smocking, high-neck yokes, or puff sleeves.
constellations.guardrail: A floral tee or one tiered skirt is not a wardrobe identity.

constellations.name: Goblincore
constellations.signature: Repeated woodland/earthy oddities: fungi, frogs, snails, beetles, mossy botanical motifs, or intentionally rustic mismatched textures.
constellations.guardrail: Witchy and Grunge are supporting, not compulsory; Food is not a proxy for mushrooms.

constellations.name: Fairy grunge
constellations.signature: Visible contrast between ethereal lace/airy layers and distressed or rough-edged pieces.
constellations.guardrail: Fairy and Grunge must have joint or coherent styling evidence, not two unrelated tagged pieces.

constellations.name: Coastal cowgirl
constellations.signature: Western footwear/denim/hat details paired with light beach-ready fabrics or shapes.
constellations.guardrail: Do not replace Resort with Romantic; a cowboy boot alone is simply Western.

constellations.name: Riviera
constellations.signature: Refined warm-weather styling: relaxed tailored linen-like pieces, restrained nautical stripes, sundresses, or refined sandals.
constellations.guardrail: Nautical stripes alone are not enough; no material-quality inference.

constellations.name: Coastal grandmother
constellations.signature: Repeated breezy relaxed layering: loose shirts, wide trousers, light knits, straw accessories, or muted coastal palettes.
constellations.guardrail: No age/gender inference; plain beige clothing alone is insufficient.

constellations.name: Hippie
constellations.signature: Repeated counterculture-linked motifs/construction: peace symbols, tie-dye, patchwork, crochet, flares, or peasant silhouettes.
constellations.guardrail: Boho + Quirky is explicitly insufficient; one novelty top does not establish the historical style.

constellations.name: Granola
constellations.signature: Practical outdoor pieces mixed with relaxed natural/craft styling: trail sandals, flannel, fleece, woven textures, or hiking references.
constellations.guardrail: Earth colors alone are not Outdoorsy; technical gear alone belongs nearer Gorpcore.

constellations.name: Gorpcore
constellations.signature: Repeated technical outdoor clothing evidence: shells, hiking footwear, trail/puffer/fleece systems, or technical fastening/storage details.
constellations.guardrail: Sporty is supporting; a puffer jacket alone is insufficient.

constellations.name: Dopamine dressing
constellations.signature: Repeated high-impact color play: bold contrasting palettes, graphic clashes, or deliberately bright statement pieces.
constellations.guardrail: Quirky alone is insufficient; avoid claiming a psychological effect from clothing tags.

constellations.name: Kidcore
constellations.signature: Repeated explicitly childhood/play-themed motifs, with playful shape or color corroboration; Cute and Quirky context on the same piece.
constellations.guardrail: Generic cartoons, novelty, animals, robots, comics, and rainbows alone are insufficient. Named characters are examples, not a required brand list.

constellations.name: Clowncore
constellations.signature: Repeated clown/jester or exaggerated costume-like construction: harlequin, ruff collars, pom-poms, oversized contrast, or deliberate clown motifs.
constellations.guardrail: A polka-dot blouse alone is not enough.

constellations.name: Y2K glam
constellations.signature: Early-2000s glamour cues recur: rhinestone graphics, velour, butterfly motifs with period shapes, baby tees, or low-rise styling.
constellations.guardrail: Cute is optional; a butterfly by itself is not period evidence.

constellations.name: Eclectic
constellations.signature: Repeated combinations of materially different influences across pieces or saved outfits, with visible contrast rather than only many labels.
constellations.guardrail: Do not require Boho or Vintage, and do not reward raw tag count as aesthetic diversity.
constellations.pending: Cross-style diversity needs an independently tested derived measure; do not substitute raw tag count.

constellations.name: Mob wife
constellations.signature: Repeated opulent styling: large-scale animal patterns, faux-fur volume, substantial gold-tone ornament, or dramatic accessories.
constellations.guardrail: Do not infer ethnicity, occupation, wealth, or real-fur content; consider a less stereotype-dependent label later.

constellations.name: Holiday sparkle
constellations.signature: Explicit seasonal motifs paired with sparkle/metallic/party styling across multiple pieces.
constellations.guardrail: A sequin party dress with no holiday connection is not Holiday sparkle.

constellations.name: Festival season
constellations.signature: Festival-use evidence plus repeated styling cues such as fringe, body chains, crochet, statement layering, or embellished practical pieces.
constellations.guardrail: Festival is an Occasion source, not a missing Aesthetic; do not make Boho mandatory.

constellations.name: Rave
constellations.signature: Repeated dance-club/rave evidence: neon, holographic/reflective finishes, mesh/fishnet, utility accessories, or explicit rave motifs.
constellations.guardrail: Sexy and Y2K are optional; one neon garment alone is insufficient.

constellations.name: Office siren
constellations.signature: Repeated intentional contrast of office tailoring with body-conscious, sheer, sharp eyewear, or sleek evening-style elements.
constellations.guardrail: Do not infer workplace behavior or require Minimalist.

constellations.name: Business casual
constellations.signature: Repeated less-formal work tailoring: trousers, blouses, relaxed blazers, fine knits, or loafers.
constellations.guardrail: The word work may refer to workwear or a seller slogan; it is not enough alone.

constellations.name: Power suit
constellations.signature: Coordinated suit evidence or substantial sharp tailoring across blazers, trousers/skirts, and structured pieces.
constellations.guardrail: Masculine is supporting, not essential; one blazer is not a Power suit wardrobe.

constellations.name: Quiet luxury
constellations.signature: Repeated restrained styling with clean construction, fine-looking textures, and little overt ornament; multiple corroborating pieces.
constellations.guardrail: Do not infer luxury/quality/wealth from fiber claims; optional clearer name: Understated elegance.

constellations.name: Scandi minimal
constellations.signature: Repeated relaxed clean lines, tactile knits, practical layering, and uncluttered silhouettes.
constellations.guardrail: Each signature piece must itself be Minimalist, with a clean relaxed shape or a Cozy knit. A Cozy tag alone cannot qualify.

constellations.name: Normcore
constellations.signature: Repeated understated everyday casual combinations: plain tees, straightforward jeans/trousers, simple knits, and low-key sneakers.
constellations.guardrail: Explicit Everyday basics remain excluded; missing detail tags do not prove Plain or Normcore.

constellations.name: Menswear
constellations.signature: Repeated menswear-inspired construction: Oxford shirts, waistcoats, brogues, suiting, or tailored trousers.
constellations.guardrail: This describes garment styling, not the user's gender; possible label: Menswear-inspired tailoring.

constellations.name: Workwear
constellations.signature: Repeated durable/work-derived construction: chore jackets, carpenter pockets, overalls, canvas/duck references, or practical reinforced shapes.
constellations.guardrail: Masculine is optional; office work is not Workwear.

constellations.name: Techwear
constellations.signature: Repeated technical urban construction: articulated cargo storage, shells, modular straps, waterproof/technical surfaces, or functional fastening systems.
constellations.guardrail: Edgy is optional; a robot graphic or Geeky tag is not Techwear.

constellations.name: Skater
constellations.signature: Repeated skate-linked combinations: roomy trousers, skate footwear, hoodies, or skate graphics with practical street styling.
constellations.guardrail: A graphic tee or checkerboard alone is insufficient; Grunge is optional.

constellations.name: Athleisure
constellations.signature: Repeated exercise-derived pieces styled for casual wear: leggings, sports bras, track/jogger shapes, performance knits, or sneakers.
constellations.guardrail: Minimalist is optional; distinguish deliberate sport-derived styling from any comfortable outfit.

constellations.name: Blokecore
constellations.signature: Football/soccer jersey or related sportswear cluster: team graphics, track layers, terrace-style footwear, or period sport silhouettes.
constellations.guardrail: Do not infer gender or fandom; unrelated striped tops are insufficient.

constellations.name: Y2K street
constellations.signature: Repeated early-2000s street cues: baggy/low-rise denim, baby tees, rhinestone/logotype graphics, or period accessories.
constellations.guardrail: A logo or cargo pocket alone is not enough.

constellations.name: Geek chic
constellations.signature: Repeated specific intellectual/fandom motifs: computing, science, games, books, math, or recognizable nerd-culture references.
constellations.guardrail: Do not require Quirky; exclude pencil-skirt silhouettes, device compatibility names, and vague science-themed product names without corroboration.
